Our Story

A Living Ministry

Led by the dynamic and anointed Pastor Rilwan Olowo Adamu and his wife Pastor Mrs. Precious Abiodun Rilwan, CGEFMI is surrounded by a Board of Trustees and dedicated leaders.

Under three years of establishment the Church has planted four daughter churches at Ikoya, Akure, Abakaliki and Adamo — a testament to their evangelical calling backed by Christ Himself.
